AL-RIḤLĀT

wa-ahl al-jabal ‘alā kharāj yu’addūnahu ilayhi, li-anna al-arāḍī fī safḥ al-jabal wa-lā quwwata lahum ‘alā ‘imāratihā illā bi-idhnih.

DHIKR THAWRAT AL-SHARĪF JALĀL AL-DĪN FĪ BILĀD MA‘BAR WA-MĀ ITTAṢALA BI-DHĀLIKA MIN QATLI-HI LI-BN AKHĪ AL-WAZĪR

kāna al-sulṭān qad wallā al-sharīf jalāl al-dīn aḥsan shāh ‘alā bilād ma‘bar, wa-hiya ‘alā masāfat sittat ashhur min dahlī. fa-kharaja ‘alayhi wa-idda‘ā al-mulk li-nafsihi, wa-qatala nuwwāb al-sulṭān wa-‘ummālahu, wa-ḍaraba al-sikka min al-dhahab wa-l-fiḍḍa bi-ismihi. fa-kataba ‘alā wajh al-dīnār: "sulālat ṭāhā wa-yāsīn, abū al-fuqarā’ wa-l-masākīn, jalāl al-dunyā wa-l-dīn." wa-kataba ‘alā al-wajh al-ākhar: "al-mutawakkil ‘alā ta’yīd al-raḥmān, aḥsan shāh al-sulṭān."
